name: codex-ws-upstream-failure-observability
title: Fix Aether Codex WebSocket upstream failure observability
description: Classify Aether Codex WebSocket client, upstream, and timeout failures correctly; preserve transport and close details in structured logs; and let the official Codex client own retries without Aether replaying requests.
creator: codex-agent
subtasks: diagnose the official Codex WebSocket 502 and retry behavior
record exact upstream protocol and transport failure details
separate client 400, upstream 502, and timeout 504 responses
preserve official WebSocket close code and reason
cover binding, active-response, idle, timeout, and close paths with tests
notes: Aether commit 2786588a1 was pushed to origin/custom. Aether performs no request retry in these paths; the official Codex client receives retryable upstream status or a closed idle connection. cargo check and the complete 100-test Codex WebSocket suite passed. No production deployment or service restart was performed.
